Weed in Chelsea & Flatiron

Chelsea and Flatiron have six licensed dispensaries and about 3,000 products, the second-deepest neighborhood in the city after Midtown. Stoops on 5th Avenue at 23rd Street is the largest at about 690, followed by The Alchemy on 8th Avenue near 25th at about 540, Poppin on 10th Avenue at about 505, Gotham Chelsea on 10th Avenue near the High Line at about 500, Bud & Honey on 5th Avenue at 27th at about 420 and Verdi on 23rd Street at about 350.

The combined menu is broad: 853 pre-rolls, 784 vapes, 748 edibles and 430 flower options, with 127 concentrates, 42 tinctures and 23 topicals. Stoops carries one of the deepest Florist Farms runs in the city and Poppin one of the deepest Ayrloom runs. Bud & Honey is the cartridge specialist with Heavy Hitters and Rove, while Gotham Chelsea is the concentrate stop on the west side. Prices start at $5 for 1906 drops and single-serve drinks at most of the six, and 5 Boro dime bags run about $10. The stores span 5th to 10th Avenue, so there is one within a few blocks of anywhere between 14th and 30th Streets.

Good to know
  • Six licensed shops from 5th to 10th Avenue, ranging from about 350 to 690 products each.
  • About 3,000 products total: 853 pre-rolls, 784 vapes, 748 edibles, 430 flower.
  • Stoops is the largest; Bud & Honey is the vape specialist; Gotham Chelsea has the most concentrates on the west side.
  • Entry prices are $5 at most shops; Verdi's floor is $7.91.
Chelsea & Flatiron FAQ
What is the biggest dispensary in Chelsea?

Stoops at 182 5th Avenue near 23rd Street, with about 690 products and a deep Florist Farms selection. The Alchemy on 8th Avenue is second at about 540.

Is there a dispensary near the High Line?

Two. Gotham Chelsea at 146 10th Avenue near 18th Street and Poppin at 317 10th Avenue near 28th Street are both a block from the High Line. Gotham is the edibles and concentrate stop; Poppin has the larger overall menu.

Which Chelsea shop is best for vapes?

Bud & Honey on 5th Avenue at 27th, with 134 vape listings and Heavy Hitters, Rove and EUREKA stocked deeply. The Alchemy and Stoops also carry large cartridge selections.
